brief:
Israeli occupation forces carried out renewed attacks across the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, IMEMC News reported, extending ceasefire violations to their 306th consecutive day. The military operations have maintained an Israeli siege that has blocked the entry of relief supplies, halted reconstruction work, and prevented medical evacuations for thousands of civilians across the territory.

Humanitarian conditions throughout Gaza have sharply deteriorated under the sustained blockade. The prolonged violations have cut off access to critical aid deliveries and essential medical services needed by the civilian population. Relief organizations have warned that the restrictions are deepening shortages of food, medicine, and fuel across the strip.
dek: Israeli occupation forces continued their attacks across the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, marking the 306th consecutive day of ceasefire violations and maintaining the siege that has blocked relief, reconstruction, and medical evacuation for thousands of civilians…
title: Israeli forces continue Gaza attacks as ceasefire violations reach 306 days
